chunks: Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan al-Ṣaffār, may Allah be pleased with him, wrote to Abū Muḥammad al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī, peace be upon him.

Regarding a woman whom her husband divorced, and he did not provide her maintenance during the waiting period, while she was in need: is it permissible for her to go out and spend the night away from her home for work and need?
So he, peace be upon him, wrote in reply: There is no harm in that if Allah knows sincerity from her.

key_terms.امْرَأَةٍ: a woman under discussion in the legal case
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible
key_terms.لِلْعَمَلِ: for work or earning a livelihood

ai.seo_question: Is a divorced woman in her ʿiddah allowed to leave home for work if her husband does not support her?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a divorced woman in her ʿiddah who has not been provided maintenance and is in need. It permits her to leave and stay away from her residence for work and necessity, on the condition of genuine sincerity before Allah.
